name: todo_write
description: Optionally maintain the current conversation's working procedure when explicit steps help manage the work. Send exactly one operation. items replaces the entire list; omit obsolete steps instead of marking them completed, and an empty list clears it. advance (true, with expected_revision) completes the single in_progress step and starts the first pending one. update ({index, status}, 0-based, with expected_revision) sets one step's status; use items to change text. Use advance or update as progress is made. expected_revision is the revision from your last result. Multiple in_progress items are allowed for parallel work. interrupted is set only by the runtime when a work period ended before completion was recorded; you cannot write it, but update can change it to another status. This is procedure memory, not a goal, acceptance check, execution permission, or instruction to continue automatically. Only the trusted conversation root may write it; delegated agents report to that root.
